title.why: Follows MEXT's page and English summary ('Primary and Secondary Education'); the cover of the translation says 'Elementary and Secondary'. Accurate rendering.

date_published.why: The Japanese text and the MEXT page give only 令和5年7月 for the provisional guideline. The 4 July 2023 date is that of a notice to boards of education about its creation, listed on the MEXT page, not of the guideline text. 2023-07 is the supported value; the blind value 2023-07-04 over-reads the notice. Convention (first issue date) is as for JP-02.

legal_force.why: '学校現場での生成AIの利活用を一律に禁止したり義務付けたりするものではない'

summary_claims.claim: five points: safety-conscious proper use (terms, age limits, parental consent), information security, protection of personal information/privacy/copyright, fairness, transparency and accountability
summary_claims.locator: page 5-6, items 1-5; literal: ①安全性を考慮した適正利用 ... ⑤透明性の確保、関係者への説明責任

summary_claims.claim: does not uniformly ban or mandate use

scope.note: Education guidance with safeguards for children's use of generative AI; scope_note present and appropriate.

note: Official MEXT documents confirm title, issuer, Ver.2.0 of 26 December 2024 and the July 2023 provisional guideline. Keep date_published 2023-07; the day in the blind extraction comes from a notice date. The notes already refer to JP-02 and JP-03, so they could be added to related. No Ver.3.0 found.
